name: Wrist Arthrofibrosis / Post-Traumatic Stiffness
definition: Persistent restriction of wrist motion after fracture, surgery, ligament injury or prolonged immobilization.

investigations.principle: Radiographs assess alignment; CT/MRI are selected for structural causes.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, postoperative, infection, occult injury or condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific pathway.

amber: Persistent mechanical block may require release.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Manibandha-Sandhi stambha phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Persistent restriction of wrist motion after fracture, surgery, ligament injury or prolonged immobilization.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, major trauma, unstable fracture/dislocation, sepsis/infection or other listed red flags.
